question: In a certain code language, 'POUR' is written as 'KLFI'. How will 'PROJECT' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 'POUR' is written as 'KLFI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc3b252ab60f730530811b0aa10ec5d4988dffcdb06fa7f16e4af24d66e654fe.png] 

Similarly,

**'PROJECT'** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aef649f6cdb9b5a270f1ad8b90297823b1f7d01ec1f5cdcadd1a711068b98f42.png] 

Hence, 'PROJECT' is coded as "**KILQVXG**".
